Definition: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
BiblicalUsage: 1) cattle, herd, oxen, ox; 1a) cattle (generic pl. but sing. in form-coll); 1b) herd (particular one); 1c) head of cattle (individually)
